name: Agencies Using a Product
query: MATCH p = (a:FedRAMP_Agency)-[:FedRAMP_Contains*0..1]->(user:FedRAMP_Agency)-[:FedRAMP_Authorizes|FedRAMP_Reuses]->(prod:FedRAMP_Product) WHERE prod.objectid = 'CHANGE' RETURN p
description: Show agencies that authorize or reuse a product, including parent→sub→product when a sub-agency holds the relationship. Click the product, copy its Object ID, replace CHANGE, then run.
